info.desc: Whirlpool is the debut album by Chapterhouse, released on 29 April 1991. .

lists.name: Pitchfork: The 50 Best Shoegaze Albums of All Time

podcast.body: Released in 1991, *Whirlpool* is identified as the band's "big contribution" to the shoegaze era. The group, like Slowdive, hailed from Reading, and the album exemplifies their sound. "Their big contribution to the shoogas era was an album called Whirlpool, which came out in 1991."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
